subject: AWS Offer launch: product page SEO, CTAs & co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Acme Analytics <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Draft offer page + SEO title/keywords — need approvals for submission

Hi team,

Attaching the first complete draft of our AWS Offer product page and the SKU/pricing spreadsheet. High-level asks below: 

1) AWS / Acme: quick compliance check — anything in the copy or screenshots that would block Seller Portal submission?
2) Vanessa / Marissa: pick the hero headline and subhead (options in the doc) and confirm CTA text (Start free trial vs Request demo). We want a single CTA that supports co-sell flows.
3) Ben: confirm the pricing tier labels in pricing_v1.csv match customer-facing language.
4) Karthik / Legal: any technical claims or data residency bullet points that need rewording before we publish.

Deadlines: planning to submit to Seller Central by 2026-08-31 to hit co-sell review for September. Please respond with firm feedback or redlines by 2026-08-24 EOD PT.

Attachments: rw_offer_page_v1.docx (copy options + screenshots), pricing_v1.csv

Notes: hero options lean toward product value for engineering teams ("Predictable LLM inference: latency you can budget for") but we have SEO constraints around 'low latency' and 'LLM serving' — suggestions welcome.

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Director, GTM Programs
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
(415) 555-0129

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer page + SEO title/keywords — need approvals for submission

+1 on timeline. Quick thoughts after a skim of rw_offer_page_v1.docx: 

- Hero: prefer Option B but tightened: "Predictable LLM inference for production apps" (shorter, matches common search queries).
- Subhead: "Low-latency, cost-aware serving across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." (keeps our differentiators).
- CTA: keep "Start free trial" as primary, add a secondary "Contact sales" link for co-sell handoffs. AWS co-sell prefers a clear trial CTA plus a Contact Sales flow.

Small nit: the screenshot alt text includes the internal metric names (token_rate) — replace with end-user phrasing (throughput).

I can consolidate copy choices into a single tracked doc if you want.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner GTM Lead, Marketplace
Redwood Inference

From: AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer page + SEO title/keywords — need approvals for submission

Thanks for the draft. A couple of platform checks from the Marketplace side: 

1) Allowed claims: We flag comparative or unverified performance claims ("50% cheaper") — you can say "cost-aware" but avoid numeric comparisons unless we have benchmark uploads and supporting methodology.
2) Security bullets: you must include the encryption in transit and at rest statements if you're listing Private deployment as an option. If data residency is claimed for regions, include specific controls.
3) Images/screenshots: do not include internal hostnames; remove any PII.

Seller id: 987654-REDWOOD. Upload the final copy, screenshots, and SKU mapping via Seller Central: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/offer/submit/12345

I've attached a brief "Seller page checklist" (aws_sellercheck.pdf) — follow items 1-4 before submission to avoid delays. If you want, I can run a pre-check once you upload the final assets.

Best,
AWS Marketplace PM
aws-marketplace@amazon.com

Attachment: aws_sellercheck.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft offer page + SEO title/keywords — legal redlines attached

Forwarding legal redlines (see attached). Highlights: 

- Remove any absolute performance guarantees; change phrasing to "typical latency" or "latency targets".
- Replace "low latency" with contextualized statements about SLOs and region-based performance where needed.
- Data residency: don't state a region unless you have explicit deployment evidence (we can say "regional deployment options available").

I've attached legal_redlines.docx with tracked changes. I'll be available for a 30-minute sync tomorrow to walk through any contested language.

Date: 2026-08-25T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer page + SEO title/keywords — need approvals for submission

Thanks everyone — consolidation below (final decisions and owners):

- Final hero: "Predictable LLM inference for production applications"
- Subhead: "Low-latency, cost-aware serving across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
- CTA: Primary = "Start free trial"; Secondary = "Contact sales" (Contact sales routes to Acme co-sell rep).
- Copy edits: Karthik's redlines accepted; remove absolute numeric performance claims and update screenshot alt text to use customer-facing metrics.
- Security/Claims: add short bullet "Encryption in transit and at rest" and replace specific regional residency claims with "regional deployment options available" per Legal.
- Pricing: Ben, please confirm final tier labels by 2026-08-27.
- Submission: Vanessa to upload final assets to Seller Central by 2026-08-29 for an AWS pre-check.
- Contract/PO: Marissa to confirm whether Acme will need a Private Offer; attaching private_offer_template_001.docx for reference.

Attachments: final copy will be rw_offer_page_v1_final.docx (not yet attached), legal_redlines.docx, private_offer_template_001.docx

Next steps: Vanessa to do the upload; Michael to schedule a 20-min check-in with AWS PM on 2026-08-30 10:00 AM PT to confirm nothing blocked.

Thanks,

Michael Grant
